modules.title: 一个品牌色怎样从令牌流向多个组件
设计令牌怎样保持一致

items.title: 先命名稳定的设计决定
items.text: 令牌应表达角色或尺度，例如品牌主色、危险提示色、卡片圆角和间距等级；名称比单个 `#` 色值或像素更能说明它为什么存在。

items.title: 组件引用同一个来源
items.text: 按钮、链接和选中状态从共享令牌读取值，主题或品牌调整时可集中更新。单个例外应先判断是否真是新的可复用规则。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 设计令牌不是设计系统的全部，也不是每一个 CSS 变量都值得成为令牌。令牌保存共享设计决定；组件、版式和内容规则仍要另行设计。把只出现一次的临时补丁命名成令牌，反而会制造噪声。

lessonPractice.title: 三个页面的主按钮都要换成新的品牌色。怎样修改更不容易遗漏？

options.label: 让按钮共用一个命名颜色，只修改这个颜色的值
options.feedback: 对。共同设计决定有一个来源，改品牌色时不会遗漏分散写死的值。

options.label: 在每个组件里分别查找并替换色值
options.feedback: 短期可行，但相同蓝色可能有不同含义，也容易漏掉某个组件或状态。

options.label: 为三个页面分别创建一份按钮颜色变量，再逐页修改
options.feedback: 令牌应承载可共享的设计决定；每个实例各有一份不会带来一致性。

en.title: Primary buttons on three pages all need to change from blue to a new brand color. Which implementation is easier to maintain?

options.label: Have buttons reference one semantic primary-brand token, change that token's value once, and check every button
options.feedback: Correct. The shared design decision has one source, so a brand-color change does not miss scattered hard-coded values.

options.label: Manually find and replace blue hex values in every component
options.feedback: This can work briefly, but the same blue may mean different things and it is easy to miss a component or state.

options.label: Create a different color token for every button used once
options.feedback: Tokens should carry reusable design decisions; one isolated token per instance does not create consistency.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把重复使用的品牌主色、错误色、间距和圆角整理为有语义的设计令牌，并让按钮、输入框和卡片引用它们。不要把只出现一次的临时值都建成令牌；改完后修改一个品牌色令牌，检查所有相关组件和深色主题是否同步。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Organize repeatedly used primary-brand color, error color, spacing, and radius values as semantic design tokens, then have buttons, inputs, and cards reference them. Do not create tokens for every one-off temporary value. Afterward, change one brand-color token and check that related components and dark theme update together.

learning.assumes: You have seen several pages use the same brand color, spacing, or corner radius.
learning.outcome: You can extract repeated values into a semantic shared token and judge when a new token is warranted instead of hard-coding one page.

modules.title: How one brand color flows from a token to several components

items.title: Name stable design decisions first
items.text: Tokens should express a role or scale such as primary brand color, danger color, card radius, or spacing step. A name explains why a value exists better than one hex color or pixel count.

items.title: Components reference one source
items.text: Buttons, links, and selected states read a shared token, so theme or brand changes can update centrally. For a one-off exception, first decide whether it is truly a new reusable rule.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Design tokens are not the whole design system, and not every CSS variable deserves to become a token. Tokens store shared design decisions; components, layout, and content rules still need separate design. Naming a one-time patch as a token creates noise.

distinctions.label: Component
distinctions.text: A {c:design-token} stores a named value for color, spacing, radius, or another design decision. A {c:component} uses those values to form reusable, interactive UI.
